models.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B

models.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B

engines.hardware: LattePanda Sigma 2 single-board computer (Intel Core Ultra X7 358H, Arc B390 graphics, up to 64GB LPDDR5X-8533)
engines.system_ram_min: 64GB LPDDR5X (up to 59GB usable for AI work)

models.why: LattePanda measured Qwen3.6-35B-A3B at around 30 tok/s in INT4 through OpenVINO on its Sigma 2 board (Core Ultra X7 358H + Arc B390, up to 64GB LPDDR5X), which it pitches as room for 35B-class quantized MoE models plus long-context KV cache.

models.name: LFM2.5-24B-A2B

engines.hardware: one A100 SXM4 (Massed Compute); L40S was the best value at 1110 tok/s per dollar
